sourceContext.originPage: WKND adventure detail page (Bali Surf Camp)

contentPattern.structure: repeating label/value rows (each row: label cell + value cell) with left accent bar, small-caps label above bold value

suitableFor: adventure detail metadata / facts sidebars (activity, difficulty, price, etc.)
any structured key/value spec list rendered as styled label-above-value rows
product or trip fact sheets with a fixed set of attributes
notSuitableFor: general side-by-side text/image layouts (use columns / columns-featured)
grids of self-contained image cards (use cards)

notes: Built on the vanilla columns base as a 2-column (label/value) table-style block. Source renders from an AEM Content Fragment definition-list (dl.cmp-contentfragment__elements). Repeated across all 16 adventure detail pages with the same 6 attributes; values differ per adventure.
